items.en: Russia launches Project 20380 corvette Grozny for the Pacific Fleet
items.nl: Rusland laat Project 20380-korvet Grozny te water voor de Pacifische Vloot
items.sEn: The Amur Shipbuilding Plant in Komsomolsk-on-Amur, in Russia's Far East, has launched the multipurpose corvette Grozny, a Project 20380 (Steregushchiy-class) ship for the Russian Navy's Pacific Fleet, the fleet's press service said (via Interfax). Volgens de persdienst van de Pacifische Vloot (via Interfax) is het een schip van Project 20380 (Steregoesjtsji-klasse) voor de Pacifische Vloot van de Russische marine. Defence Bl…

items.en: «Ні, ні, ні, зараз це мій!»: як екіпаж «Фауста» дронами-перехоплювачами збив уже 17 російських БПЛА (ArmyInform: 'No, no, no, this one is mine now! How the Faust crew has downed 17 Russian UAVs with interceptor drones')
items.nl: ArmyInform: bemanning van 'Faust' schoot met interceptordrones al 17 Russische UAV's neer, waaronder Gerbera en Orlan
items.sEn: Citing Ukraine's Air Command 'Centre', ArmyInform profiles an interceptor-drone operator with the call sign 'Faust'. It says his crew has destroyed 17 Russian UAVs, among them a Gerbera decoy/attack drone and an Orlan reconnaissance drone. items.en: Zelensky accuses the US of deliberately slowing Patriot and NASAMS interceptor deliveries Ukraine's allies have paid for, as Kyiv asks Lockheed Martin to sell it more PAC-3 MSE and repair F-16s in Ukraine

items.en: «Ланцети», «Орлани» і «Князь»: Пілоти Signum за ніч знищили 25 російських безпілотників різних типів (ArmyInform: Lancets, Orlans and 'Knyaz' – Signum pilots destroyed 25 Russian drones of various types overnight)
items.nl: Oekraïense drone-eenheid Signum meldt 25 Russische drones in één nacht neergehaald, onder meer Zala, Lancet en de nieuwe verkenner 'Knjaz Vesjtsji Oleg'
items.sEn: Ukrainian state outlet ArmyInform reports that drone pilots of the Signum unit of the 57th Separate Motorised Infantry Brigade shot down 25 Russian UAVs of various types during one night of 'air patrol' over Ukrainian territory, and released video of the engagements. items.en: «Усі їхні тактики вже вивчені»: у 115-й бригаді розповіли про полювання на ворожі БПЛА
items.nl: "Al hun tactieken zijn al bestudeerd": 115e brigade over de jacht op vijandelijke drones
items.sEn: ArmyInform relays an interview given to Suspilne by Chief Sergeant "Hector" of a drone-interception battery in Ukraine's 115th Brigade. The unit counters Russian reconnaissance drones (Zala, Orlan, Supercam) and attack drones (Shaheds, Gerbers, Molniya).
items.sNl: ArmyInform geeft een interview weer dat hoofdsergeant "Hector" van een drone-onderscheppingsbatterij van Oekraïnes 115e brigade aan Suspilne gaf. De eenheid bestrijdt Russische verkenningsdrones (Zala, Orlan, Supercam) en aanvalsdrones (Shaheds, Gerbers, Molniya).

items.en: Africa Corps fielded a Ukraine-war Molniya kamikaze drone in Mali; it came down near JNIM fighters
items.nl: Africa Corps zette in Mali een Molniya-kamikazedrone uit de Oekraïne-oorlog in; die kwam neer bij JNIM-strijders
items.sEn: Russia's Africa Corps, the Defence Ministry-run successor to Wagner in the Sahel, used a Molniya kamikaze drone against fighters of the al-Qaeda-linked JNIM near Dioura in Mali's Mopti region, Euromaidan Press reports. items.en: Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps says its air defence forced Russian Rubicon unit to relocate

items.sEn: According to Militarnyi, the air-defence commander of Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps says the Russian unmanned-systems unit Rubicon has been 'almost entirely' redeployed to another front sector because its reconnaissance and strike drones ceased to be effective.
